brand.name: Red Anchor
brand.description: Nautical/naval-rank themed line under United Cigars, made at Kelner Boutique Factory (KBF). 25 cigars per box. The Admiral released 2022; Captain, Commodore, Gunner, Cooper launched/announced at PCA 2023.

line.name: Red Anchor
line.filler: Dominican San Vicente, Dominican Habano '92, Pennsylvania tobacco
line.notes: Single blend across all vitolas, differing only in shape/size.

research_notes: UC-RedAnchor_Anch-Cap_01.jpg likely refers to the Captain vitola but wasn't fully confirmed. Only 5 photos exist for this brand.
